name: team-habits
description: An agent that keeps how the team works written down.

subscriptions.name: A task finishes with a note on how it went
subscriptions.prompt:
If this change did not finish the task, or the task has no note on how it went, stop.

Read the note. If it says something about how the team works — what went well, what went badly — write it down in your memory.

subscriptions.name: Every Friday at 16:00
subscriptions.prompt: Read what you wrote down this week. If two or more notes point the same way, propose a change to How we work as a draft document, and say which tasks it comes from.
